name: 7-Day Virechana & Kati Basti Protocol
description: Classical Pitta-Vata shodhana cleansing paired with localized lumbar retention snehana for Katigraha and musculoskeletal stiffness.
baseDietGuidelines: Strict Laghu Ushna diet, warm ginger water, avoid sour curd, fermented foods, and heavy pulses.

stages.name: Deepana & Pachana Priming
stages.preInstructions: Trikatu Churna 2g with lukewarm water twice daily before meals.
stages.postInstructions: Assess appetite and absence of Ama before starting Snehapana.

stages.name: Snehapana & Sarvanga Swedana
stages.preInstructions: Empty stomach administration of medicated Ghritha in graduated doses.
stages.postInstructions: Warm water hydration only. Light rice gruel (Manda/Peya) when hungry.

stages.name: Pradhana Virechana Karma
stages.preInstructions: Administer classical Trivrit Lehyam / Eranda Taila formulation at 07:30 AM.
stages.postInstructions: Monitor and record Vega count, pulse, hydration, and exhaustion index.

stages.name: Samsarjana Krama & Kati Basti
stages.preInstructions: Sequential diet restoration (Peya -> Vilepi -> Yusha). Warm Sahacharadi Taila Kati Basti.
stages.postInstructions: Avoid direct draft, excessive speech, sun exposure, and heavy physical exercise.

name: 7-Day Classical Virechana Protocol
description: Standardized Pitta purification regimen for chronic Amlapitta, metabolic heat, and inflammatory skin disorders.
baseDietGuidelines: Pitta shamaka pathya, bitter and sweet infusions, strict prohibition of pungent and salted foods.

stages.name: Abhyantar Snehapana (Mahatiktaka Ghrita)
stages.preInstructions: Early morning ingestion of medicated bitter ghee.

name: 14-Day Janu Basti & Patra Pinda Sweda
description: Intensive Vata-Kapha pacification protocol for osteoarthritic degenerative joints, stiffness, and inflammation.
baseDietGuidelines: Vata-hara warm unctuous diet, sesame oil, garlic milk, avoiding dry and cold foods.

stages.name: Deepana & Sthanika Abhyanga
stages.preInstructions: Herbal tea with ginger, local warm oil application.

stages.name: Janu Basti & Patra Pinda Sweda
stages.preInstructions: Ksheerabala 101 Taila dam ring retention on bilateral knees.

name: 7-Day Nasya & Shirodhara Protocol
description: Classical neuro-vascular Shiro-Roga management for Ardhavabhedaka (migraine), insomnia, and cranial stress.
baseDietGuidelines: Cooling, easily digestible meals, avoiding nightshades and caffeinated triggers.

stages.name: Mukha Abhyanga & Nadi Swedana
stages.preInstructions: Facial and cervical warm oil massage.
stages.postInstructions: Mild localized herbal steam to liquefy cranial doshas.

stages.name: Marsha Nasya & Shirodhara
stages.preInstructions: Instillation of Anu Taila (6 drops each nostril) followed by Ksheerabala Shirodhara.
stages.postInstructions: Warm water gargling, keep head covered from wind.

stages.name: Kavala & Dhumapana Shiro-Prasadana
stages.preInstructions: Medicated smoke inhalation and sesame oil swishing.
